description: Single old wind-shaped woodland SPRUCE in the elevated three-quarter view of a top-down 16-bit fantasy RPG. One complete isolated pixel art tree. Uneven pointed spire, loose heavy green boughs drape in meandering scalloped tiers. Sprays of needles represented as tapered little 3-6 pixel hooked clusters, readable broad branching silhouette with generous overlapping foliage; trunk peeks between dark interior boughs, gnarled mossy root feet. Slightly stronger growth to the right, asymmetrical, no Christmas-tree decoration or perfectly symmetrical triangles. Hand-pixeled look, pine teal, emerald, dusty sage highlights, indigo-green undersides and desaturated plum-brown bark. Deliberate small limited color ramps, crisp clustered marks and selective outline. Neutral base color for later in-game lighting. No photo, 3D, atmospheric effect, ground tile, background, cast shadow, pot, other items, labels or writing. Entire tree fully visible against transparent pixels, almost filling the tall canvas.
